name: 4-Channel Relay Module
description: GPIO-controlled 4-channel relay module for switching AC/DC loads. Active LOW. Each channel can switch up to 10A 250VAC.

operations.name: relay_on
operations.desc: Turn on a relay channel (active LOW — set GPIO to 0)

operations.name: relay_off
operations.desc: Turn off a relay channel (set GPIO to 1)

operations.name: relay_status
operations.desc: Read current state of all relay channels
